text:
Predicates:
HasF1Visa(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
HasJ1Visa(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student.
NeedsToApplyForCPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT.
NeedsToApplyForOPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for OPT.
WantsToWorkInUS(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
Mike ::: Mike
Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) → (HasF1Visa(x) ∨ HasJ1Visa(x))) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x (HasF1Visa(x) ∧ WantsToWorkInUS(x)) → (NeedsToApplyForCPT(x) ∨ NeedsToApplyForOPT(x)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if they want to work in the US.
InternationalStudent(Mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
WantsToWorkInUS(Mike) ::: Mike wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
HasJ1Visa(Mike) ::: Mike has a J1 visa.
